# Archival Dispatch: 18 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Paul Harvey, Magic Island, and Cocoanut Grove Remotes

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Paul Harvey, The Rest of the Story, Magic Island, Sci-Fi OTR, Cocoanut Grove, Phil Harris, Gus Arnheim, Jimmie Grier, Original Filenames

## Batch 29 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 29 resolves 18 historical master radio broadcasts across three golden eras: 5 network master editions of ***Paul Harvey's The Rest of the Story*** and ABC News Commentaries (exploring Christopher Columbus, Ernest Hemingway's youth, Julian Altman's stolen Stradivarius, and Diana Ross), 7 serial episodes of the pioneering 1936 science-fiction adventure ***Magic Island*** (following the search for Joan Gregory in the undersea civilization of Euclidia), and 6 live remote big band dance transcriptions from the glamorous ***Cocoanut Grove*** in Los Angeles' Ambassador Hotel (featuring Phil Harris, Gus Arnheim, and Jimmie Grier).

---
